en.description:
A one-thumb reflex game for Apple Watch.

A pointer sweeps around your cat. Tap when it crosses a paw to score and send it back the other way. Chain hits to climb the multiplier — every hit is worth more than the last, and letting the chain drop costs you the whole climb.

Watch what you tap. Fish treats buy you time. The teaser wand freezes the clock. But the cat's belly is a trap, and three greedy taps end the run.

- A run starts at 30 seconds; fish treats stretch it
- Two modes, Relaxed and Challenge, one tap apart on the start screen
- Four cats and five scenes — one of each free, the rest bought with coins you earn
- Your five best scores, kept on your watch
- English and 简体中文
- No account, no ads, no internet. Nothing leaves your watch.
en.releaseNotes:
Two ways to play, and coins ten times faster.

• New mode button on the start screen. Relaxed slows the pointer and sends targets your way more often — a calmer fidget for a spare minute. Challenge keeps the original feel.
• Coins now arrive every 1,000 points instead of every 10,000, so a single run actually pays for something. Relaxed earns half of Challenge.
• Top 5 marks Challenge runs with a trophy, so both modes can share one list.
• The guide now spells out what a miss really costs: a thousand points, a second, and a stalled pointer.

Your coins, cats, themes and scores all carry over.
en.subtitle: Pet the cat, keep the combo
